title: Structure complete
body: The building structure and precast panel installation are complete, and the crane has left the site. Work continues on the remaining stages of construction at RECPLACE Professional Centre.

images.imageAlt: Front aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre with the building structure and precast panels in place
Angled aerial view of the RECPLACE structure and roof beside Highway 16

title: The roof is going on
body: Roof work is underway at RECPLACE Professional Centre as construction continues across the building's full three-storey form.

images.imageAlt: Wide aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre and its construction site beside Highway 16
Aerial view of the RECPLACE construction site within Prince George's commercial corridor
Closer aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre's concrete three-storey structure and roof framing

title: Third floor is in
body: The third floor is now in place, bringing RECPLACE Professional Centre to its full three-storey form.
imageAlt: Wide aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre after the third floor was installed

title: Third floor underway
body: Construction has progressed to the third level as the building's full scale takes shape.
imageAlt: Aerial view of RECPLACE with third-floor construction underway

title: Precast installation begins
body: Precast wall panels arrived on site and installation began, marking the start of vertical construction.
imageAlt: Crane, precast wall panels, and installation activity at the RECPLACE site

title: Foundation work establishes the footprint
body: Footings and foundation work established the building footprint as site work advanced through June.
imageAlt: Aerial detail of RECPLACE footings and foundation work

title: Groundbreaking
body: Construction officially begins at RECPLACE Professional Centre, marking the start of work at 2740 Recplace Drive.
imageAlt: Project attendees taking part in the RECPLACE groundbreaking ceremony
